message: Mutable shared state detected — use thread-safe patterns

evaluator_config.message_template: Function '{name}' uses mutable shared state — use thread-safe patterns

rationale: Unprotected shared state under concurrent access causes data races, torn reads, and corrupted state. These failures are non-deterministic and nearly impossible to reproduce.
remediation: Use threading.Lock, queue.Queue, or immutable data structures to protect shared state.
